title: Concept: hardcoded API key assignment
description: An API key assigned inline in source travels with the code into forks, logs and backups, and every copy is a working credential. A secret store is what makes rotation possible without a code change.
applicability: Any source file that assigns a credential-looking value to a key-like name.
risk: Third-party API abuse billed to the owner; MEDIUM severity until the key is shown to be live.
